decisions.proposed_text: Giữ Mood ở 【Great】 và tham gia ít nhất 15 Cuộc đua cấp G2 hoặc G1,\n giành 3 chiến thắng liên tiếp ở các Cuộc đua từ G2 trở lên, bao gồm Kikuka Sho
decisions.reason: The named top Mood state 绝好调 should use the established Great label; generic race wording should remain canonical.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires Mood, Cuộc đua, G1 and G2; established Mood-state naming uses Great for 绝好调.

decisions.reason: Correctly requires three wins in races where the specified agitation state occurred; no canonical replacement for the state label is embedded.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded generic race terminology is satisfied.

decisions.reason: Correctly preserves the eight-length debut margin and first-popularity wins in all four named races.
Correctly requires three third-place G1 finishes and at least 320000 fans.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires Cuộc đua, G1 and Số fan; all are present.

decisions.reason: Correctly preserves the Mejiro-named Mã Nương G1 condition, the three named race wins and fan threshold.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires Mã Nương, Cuộc đua, G1 and Số fan; all are present.

decisions.reason: Correctly preserves five Mile graded wins, the rainy-race requirement, and a five-length Mile Championship victory.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires Cuộc đua and Mile; both are present.

decisions.reason: Correctly preserves six first-popularity G1 participations, the three named wins and fan threshold.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires Cuộc đua, G1, Mile and Số fan; all are present.

decisions.reason: Correctly preserves End Closer, six graded wins while first favorite and undefeated, plus two final-straight overtake wins.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded context requires End Closer and Cuộc đua; both are present.

decisions.proposed_text: Giữ chuỗi thắng và giành ít nhất 8 chiến thắng ở các giải trọng thưởng, bao gồm Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn),\nJapan Cup và Arima Kinen
decisions.reason: Named race identities should retain the established international English season qualifiers rather than Vietnamese parenthetical translations.

decisions.proposed_text: Dùng chiến thuật 「Front Runner」, giữ chuỗi thắng và giành ít nhất 9 chiến thắng tại các Cuộc đua trọng thưởng Dirt (G1, G2 và G3),\nbao gồm JBC Classic, Teio Sho và Tokyo Daishoten
decisions.reason: Current text calques the established Front Runner running style and Dirt surface label.
decisions.terminology_basis: Project audit policy requires Front Runner and Dirt; embedded context requires Cuộc đua, G1, G2 and G3.
